name: Tom Giblins Irish Pub
notes: Permanently closed. Yelp business page marked CLOSED and Gayot's listing states outright 'THIS RESTAURANT IS CLOSED', both independent of each other, both for the Carlsbad, CA location. No successor or reopening found.

name: The Falcons Lure
notes: A dive/sports bar at 7745-7747 University Ave, La Mesa CA. MapQuest lists it 'Permanently closed.' San Diego Reader and an obituary both corroborate it existed at that address and describe it in the past. No priced menu was ever going to be reachable for this bar/pool-table venue even if open; closure is confirmed independently.

name: Greek Sombrero
notes: 12891 Campo Rd, Spring Valley CA. MapQuest lists it 'CLOSED'. The current occupant's own site, Steele 94, states in its history page it was 'formerly known as Valentin's Bar & Grill and the Greek Sombrero' at that address -- a replaced-at-address confirmation from an independent, first-party source.

name: Phils Place
notes: On Mission Avenue, Oceanside CA. Two separate San Diego Union-Tribune articles (2009, 2010) confirm it closed and its neon sign was sold off; no current Google Maps listing exists for a Phil's Place in Oceanside; nostalgic Facebook mentions refer to it only in past tense. A different, unrelated 'Phil's Place' found in searches is in Boca Raton, FL.

name: Club Montage
notes: 2028 Hancock St (work list gives 2030 Hancock St, same block) matches the address on file. Yelp marks it CLOSED; a San Diego subreddit thread and the current occupant's own site (Spin Nightclub, same 2028 Hancock Street address) confirm it was renamed/replaced. A nightclub, not primarily food-service.

name: Filling Station Pub and Grill
notes: The website on file (fillingstationpubandgrill.com) is a wrong-branch match: it resolves (via Wayback, since the live site now sits behind an sgcaptcha bot wall) to a same-named restaurant at 77 East Main Street, Webster, NY -- not a San Diego business. Searching independently found the actual San Diego restaurant at 9522 Miramar Rd; MapQuest marks it 'Permanently closed', and Yelp/GigTown/BBB confirm the address is now 'Off Base Bar (formerly Filling Station Pub)'. Confirmed closed/replaced at its correct address by multiple independent sources.
